decision.retained: Mode3 row-pair, native compile-time opt-in --q8-row-pair, OFF by default.
decision.rejected: Mode1 early and Mode2 one-tile lookahead: no repeatable gain / substantial regression.
decision.dispatch_guards: SM70, two-pass residual, measured 27B TP shapes, T8..32 only. Neutral GDN-out T8 falls back; all single-request, MTP T1..3, tiny or unqualified shapes fall back.
decision.full_model_validation: Pending a maintenance window; no full-model Qwen3.8/native quality, single-request speed, or serving TPS claim. Production llama.cpp was never replaced.
decision.occupancy: Row-pair can be faster with lower achieved occupancy; do not maximize occupancy as the objective.
decision.compute_counter_limit: ALU-pipe metric is a partial instruction-pipe diagnostic, NOT achieved DP4A TOPS or total compute utilization. Earlier IPA metric returned zero and is not useful as DP4A utilization.
